mission: Session persistence architecture — KILO_DNA_GAP permanent wall vs fixable STATE-SNAPSHOT gap

kilo_sessions_dir.ceiling_documentation: COLD-START-BOOT.md:178-182 -> 'Kilo sessions will ALWAYS produce hollow DNA... It is an environment ceiling, not a bug.'
kilo_sessions_dir.root_cause: Kilo environment writes only commands and pastedContents blobs to disk. session-capture.ps1 cannot extract full conversation turns because they do not exist on disk.

state_snapshot_gap.fix_path: Update STATE-SNAPSHOT.json directly with current git state + SOULCOUNT query. No JSONL required.

no_work_queue.finding: No work queue exists for pending tasks between runs
no_work_queue.impact: Every KILO_HOLLOW run starts blind — no carryover of open loops, blockers, or pending actions
no_work_queue.proposed_fix: Create .kilo/sessions/state-{run}.json with: {run, head, soulcount, phetrail_count, ledger_tail_sha, open_loops: [], blockers: []}

proposed_state_pipeline.does_not_require: JSONL, session-capture.ps1, or any Kilo environment transcript
proposed_state_pipeline.invocation: Register-EngineEvent PowerShell.Exiting -> state-capture.ps1 (same pattern as Invoke-PhetrailSeal in obi.ps1:127-129)

verdict.impact: KILO_DNA_GAP is permanent — accept it. But STATE-SNAPSHOT.json gap is fixable and has been left broken for 16 runs. .kilo/sessions/ empty means zero state continuity. Build the state-{run}.json pipeline to bypass KILO_DNA_GAP entirely.
required_action: 1. ACCEPT KILO_DNA_GAP as permanent (do not re-investigate per COLD-START-BOOT.md:179)
2. CREATE SCRIPTS/state-capture.ps1: captures git HEAD, SOULCOUNT, phetrail count, ledger tail SHA at session exit
3. UPDATE STATE-SNAPSHOT.json from state-capture.ps1 output — eliminates 16-run staleness
4. REGISTER state-capture.ps1 in obi.ps1 via Register-EngineEvent PowerShell.Exiting (pattern from obi.ps1:127-129)

negative_trails: .kilo/sessions/ empty — zero session state persisted between runs
KILO_DNA_GAP is permanent architectural ceiling — cannot be fixed from within Kilo (documented COLD-START-BOOT.md:178-182)
STATE-SNAPSHOT.json 16 runs stale despite being fixable — no update mechanism invoked
No work queue for pending tasks — every run starts blind
session-capture.ps1 exists but produces zero JSONL in Kilo environment — expected failure per KILO_DNA_GAP
L30 BOOT_FILE_AGE_SWEEP silently failing because STATE-SNAPSHOT never gets updated

evidence_chain.obi_exit_event: SCRIPTS/obi.ps1:127-129 -> Register-EngineEvent pattern for session exit

cross_references: COLD-START-BOOT.md:182 (OB-1 does DEATH SEAL, Kilo does CODE WORK)
